The EcoCompute skill is a prompt-only advisory tool designed to provide energy efficiency recommendations for LLM inference. It contains no executable code, host environment interactions, or suspicious network requests, and its instructions (SKILL.md) are strictly focused on guiding the AI agent to provide data-driven advice based on provided benchmark tables and external datasets (e.g., Zenodo 18900289).
